newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to stay weak while 107-28 holds.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to stay weak while 107-28 holds.

text.p: U.S. June T-bond futures have little chance of making meaningful progress unless they can overcome resistance around 107-28, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
"It's a put up or shup up type of thing," said Tom Hobson, director of technical analysis at Merrill Lynch in London.
"The market is extremely oversold, it has every reason for a corrective recovery and it can't. When a market does that it tells you that it is vulnerable," he said.
June T-bonds at 1100 GMT were at 107-15, up 2/32 from the prior close.
Hobson said the 38.2 percent retracement of the last selloff came in at 107-28 while there was also consolidative resistance stretching up to 107-31.
Stavros Loizou, manager, strategic trading group at Fuji Bank in London, identified a wider band of resistance in the same area.

"On the upside, there's very good resistance at 107-26 and above that 108-04," he said. "The market is trying to put in a bottom but we won't have any evidence of that being attained unless we take out 107-26."
Resistance around 107-26 has capped the market through April, with the market reaching highs there on April 3 and April 4 and a 107-24 high on Tuesday.
Loizou added: "T-bonds had an outside day down yesterday which is theoretically technically negative but they have been fairly rangebound."
He said there was solid support around 107-00. That was just below the April 7 low and a psychological round number.
